in_marathi.name: Ratna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ratna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Ratna refers to a jewel, a treasure, or a precious stone. It is believed that possessing a Ratna can bring wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. Ratna is also a name of a goddess, signifying beauty, grace, and purity.
